task: Tell me about the courier Y switch
answer:
The decision "Switch west region deliveries to Courier Y to cut cost" was made on 18 Aug at 12:00 by Lucas Martin and affects Hub W2.

*   The decision assumed Courier Y delivers at least 90% on time through Hub W2; this week it is 77% (based on 111 scans).
*   At the same time "Run the Festive Flash Sale (40% off kitchen) in the west" was running: 58% of parcels through Hub W2 in the window used the FEST40 coupon.
*   The following decisions rely on this: "Offer 2-day delivery to west customers" and "End the west backup courier contract".
*   Links between decisions are overlaps in the data, not causes.
